thread:
diego_cs: Heads-up: sketching a compact "renewal rescue" micro-runbook for accounts showing activation friction. Goal: 1-page CSM checklist + a few engineer-friendly snippets. dropping draft here for quick review.

sophia_cs: love it. keep the CSM side 6 bullets max so it's easy to paste into notes.

diego_cs: agreed. draft checklist below (CS copy-paste):
- quick health: last 24h success rate >= 98% and 95p latency < SLA target
- prefill status: enabled? TTL tuned to idle (default 30s)
- streaming: enabled for interactive demos; enable client fallback if not
- capture: 3 sample prompts + expected outputs from customer
- mitigation plan: enable extra prefill pool + notify SRE if >2 incidents in 7d
- VOC: send 3-question pulse after go-live (latency, accuracy, top flows)

neal_sre: add two triage commands for SRE to run on first contact. paste below: 

```
# quick SRE triage (prometheus-ish / log queries - pseudocode)
errors = query("sum(rate(request_errors[30m])) by (tenant")
lat95 = query("histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(latency_bucket[1h])) by (le))")
# if lat95 > baseline*2 -> increase prefill pool, enable extra batch workers
```

viv_se: for enablement email include this tiny snippet so customer demos fail less: 

```
// client fallback (pasteable)
if (client.supportsStreaming) {
  connect('stream');
} else if (server.prefillReady) {
  loadPrefill();
} else {
  callSync();
}
```

rachel_pm: can we define the RenewalRisk flag rules? propose: 3+ activation incidents OR avg 95p latency > SLA for 14d -> auto-tag RenewalRisk in CRM. Also require CSM review before outreach.

diego_cs: added. also added shortest outreach template for CSMs when flag fires: 1) empathize + status, 2) mitigation steps taken, 3) ask for 2 critical flows, 4) propose 30min sync. short and pragmatic.

ops-bot: Reminder: attach runbook link when opening SRE ticket -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/renewal-rescue :bell:

neal_sre: small note: include rollback checklist if a recent change triggered regression (rollback model quantization, revert deployment, disable new batching).

diego_cs: done. final ask: can reviewers react if OK to publish to shared playbooks (short doc store)?

sophia_cs: :thumbsup:

neal_sre: :thumbsup:

viv_se: :thumbsup: minor wording nits later

rachel_pm: :thumbsup: go ahead

diego_cs: thanks all  I'll publish and add the one-pager to the onboarding bundle.
